connector.name: Lightpaper MCP
connector.registryDescription: API-first publishing platform. Publish markdown as permanent web pages with quality scoring.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package lightpaper-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace org.lightpaper. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY
env.description: Your lightpaper.org API key (lp_free_xxx). Optional — the server can create accounts interactively.

env.name: LIGHTPAPER_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for the lightpaper API. Defaults to https://lightpaper.org.
